alt: An open studio with kitchen at one end and desk at the other, seen from inside the full space with a mezzanine overhead. Amber stained-glass pendants hang over the island. Four frames show the same room in different material schemes: terracotta walls with dark cabinetry; chalk walls with cane cabinetry; dark walls with pale cabinetry; and cane walls with terracotta cabinetry. Chrome and smoked-glass seventies furniture. First light from a courtyard, cold and blue.
text:
the amber glass doesn't change. the walls do.

same studio, same pendants shown four ways. the palette shifts what the light does—not the glass, the context. morning light reads cold and blue through the courtyard.
